checks.text: The page shows the heading "Medication Reminder" and the text "No medications yet" when no medications have been added.

Typing "Lisinopril" in the field labelled "Medication name", "10 mg" in the field labelled "Dose", and "08:00" in the field labelled "Time", then clicking the button "Add medication" adds a list item containing "Lisinopril", "10 mg", and "08:00", and the text "No medications yet" is gone.
After adding "Lisinopril" 10 mg at 08:00, clicking the button "Log dose" on the Lisinopril item adds a log entry showing "Lisinopril 10 mg taken at 08:00" in the "Dose log" section.
After logging a dose for Lisinopril, clicking the button "Delete Lisinopril" removes the medication from the list and the "Dose log" section shows "No doses logged".

Clicking the tab "History" shows a table with columns "Date", "Medication", "Dose", and "Time", and after logging Lisinopril 10 mg at 08:00, the table contains a row with "Lisinopril", "10 mg", and "08:00".
With Lisinopril 10 mg at 08:00 added, clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard that contains the header "Medication,Dose,Time" and the row "Lisinopril,10 mg,08:00".
After adding "Metformin" 500 mg at 12:00, the list shows two items: "Lisinopril" and "Metformin", and the "Dose log" section is empty.
Typing "Lis" in the field labelled "Search" filters the list to show only the item containing "Lisinopril" and hides "Metformin".
Reload keeps the medication "Lisinopril" with dose "10 mg" and time "08:00" in the list, and the logged dose "Lisinopril 10 mg taken at 08:00" in the "Dose log" section.
